capabilities: manually arrange explorer items via drag-and-drop
set a different sorting mode per folder
pin important files to the top
hide files manually or by pattern
extras: The manifest carries a staff disclaimer that the plugin has not been manually reviewed; installation is also possible via the BRAT beta plugin or manual download.
problem: Obsidian's file explorer only offers fixed sort orders and shows every item, with no manual arrangement, pinning, or pattern-based hiding.
